name: revealline
description: Reveal Line — a territory-capture arcade game

paragraphs: A configurable, Xonix-inspired browser game: leave safe ground, draw a vulnerable cut, close it and reveal a picture. Four visual worlds share the same engine: Ukrainian FPV Front, Ukrainian heritage, 1990s arcade and fictional spend management.

Play: current public game · release explorer. The cross-mode execution register is the current authority for accepted releases, qualified source, evidence and remaining work. Delivery priorities retains player requirements and dated checkpoints. The detailed delivery history and production checkpoints retain earlier observations; their dated pending/latest wording does not identify today's public edition.

The game includes local scores, replay-backed saved flights, a picture collection, optional chapter installation, a separate two-player couch race, configurable enemies/equipment, MP3 libraries and playlists, and both Immediate and Grid + buffer turning. Releasing a direction keeps the craft moving. In revised Arcade chapters, closing a cut stops it; a fresh direction starts the next move. Enemy contact with an unfinished line creates a travelling impact, leaving a chance to reconnect before it reaches the craft. Older editions retain their own rules.
